script_text: Virgo, as an Earth sign, this week Mercury fires a rare trine with Jupiter that will truly reshape your entire week. From Monday through Wednesday, the Sun sits in your fifth house igniting creative energy, but Mercury squares Saturn on Tuesday — your worst day for contracts or decisions. Wednesday marks the turning point when Venus enters your seventh house of partnership, shifting your focus toward love. Thursday through Sunday, the Moon activates your tenth house spotlighting career and public reputation. The weekend brings a Mars-Pluto conjunction unlocking a professional breakthrough. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your seventh house, opening doors in love and partnerships. Tuesday is your worst day because Mercury squares Saturn, creating delays and miscommunications that could cost you. Hold off on major financial commitments until Thursday, when your career sector lights up with supportive energy. Follow for daily updates.
